description: Digest pins for the container images this repo builds on and scans with. Dependabot keeps Go, npm and GitHub Actions; it cannot update the ARG-driven FROM lines and the KEY=image pins in deploy/versions.env, which is what this file is for. Every image string appears in several files (versions.env is the source of truth; the Dockerfile ARG defaults and compose fallbacks restate it and `make check-docker` fails when they drift), so one update touches all of them in one PR.

packageRules.description: Base and tooling images move as one PR so versions.env, the Dockerfiles and the compose files never disagree.

Alloy is a schema bump, not a pin bump: a new tag needs `make schema`, an overlay review and the fleet revalidation sweep (tools/alloy-schema-gen/README.md). Renovate may refresh the DIGEST behind the pinned tag; it must not propose a new tag.
Go and Node majors are toolchain decisions (go.mod, deploy/versions.env, ci.yml move together); minors and digests are routine.

The kind node image is tag-pinned by hand: a bump must stay inside kind v0.33 / helm/kind-action support, above NGF and CNPG's kubeVersion floors (same reasons as the deploy/versions.env comment) — a reviewed decision, not a Monday PR. No matchUpdateTypes, so digest pinning is off too.

customManagers.description: KEY=image:tag@sha256:digest lines in deploy/versions.env, ARG defaults in the Dockerfiles, and ${VAR:-image:tag} fallbacks in the compose files.
